source.title: Conductive Collagen-Based Hydrogel Combined With Electrical Stimulation to Promote Neural Stem Cell Proliferation and Differentiation

formulation.evidence: 1 ml of a pyrrole aqueous solution (concentrations of 0 mM, 20 mM, 40 mM, or 60 mM) was mixed with 1 ml of a collagen solution (10 mg/ml)
1 ml of a pyrrole aqueous solution (concentrations of 0 mM, 20 mM, 40 mM, or 60 mM) was mixed with 1 ml of a collagen solution (10 mg/ml)
Ferric chloride oxidant (molar ratio of pyrrole to ferric chloride 1:4)
the mixed solution was soaked in a genipin solution (0.3 wt%)

processing.evidence: The cross-linking treatment was carried out at 37°C for 24 h.
the electrical stimulation (200 mV) was performed for 30 min every day

youngs_modulus.evidence: The Young’s moduli of Col/PPy0, Col/PPy20, and Col/PPy40 hydrogels were 654.5 ± 10.32 Pa, 1241.3 ± 20.4 Pa, and 2,684.5 ± 30.2 Pa, respectively

conductivity.evidence: The conductivity of Col/PPy40 hydrogel is the highest (0.176 ± 0.07 S/cm)

biology.cell_type: neural stem cells from embryonic (E15-16) rat neocortex

culture_days.evidence: The NSCs were cultured on hydrogels with and without ES for 3 d and 7 days in a differentiation medium.

viability_percent.evidence: The highest percentage of viable NSCs was the Col/PPy40 + ES group (91.2 ± 4.8%)

neurite_length.evidence: The longest neurite length (170.8 ± 37.2 μm) was observed in the Col/PPy40 + ES hydrogel group

other_outcomes.evidence: On the 28th day, the degradation residual weights of Col/PPy20, Col/PPy40, and Col/PPy60 were 45.11 ± 3.25%, 51.33 ± 2.78, and 55.24 ± 4.11%, respectively.
other_outcomes.name: remaining weight after 28 days in collagenase

other_outcomes.evidence: ES group (4.7 ± 1.2) were significantly higher than those in the Col/PPy40 (3.1 ± 1.0) and Col/PPy0 (2.2 ± 0.9) groups
other_outcomes.name: number of branch points, Col/PPy40 + ES

other_outcomes.evidence: were significantly higher than those in the Col/PPy40 (3.1 ± 1.0) and Col/PPy0 (2.2 ± 0.9) groups
other_outcomes.name: number of branch points, Col/PPy40 without ES

survival.evidence: The highest percentage of viable NSCs was the Col/PPy40 + ES group (91.2 ± 4.8%)
followed by Col/PPy40 (80.5 ± 4.7%), and Col/PPy0 (73.5 ± 4.8%) groups

notes: ES: 200 mV square-wave DC pulses via Pt electrodes, 30 min daily. Degradation in collagenase 1 U/ml at 37°C.
